overview: BRF is an AI-powered SaaS platform that helps local service businesses get booked, ranked, and fundable through automation, CRM, reputation management, and lead generation.
features: Premium real estate landing page for agents and brokers
Dynamic scorecard with rules-based instant scores and AI-generated explanations
9 audience selector cards (Solo Agent, Broker, Luxury, Listing, Buyer, Investor, Commercial, New Agent) that pre-fill the demo form
13 full page sections including hero, pain points, Booked/Ranked/Fundable framework, before/after comparison, offer stack, FAQ
Sticky CTA bar with smart scroll visibility
All CTAs route to unified BRF demo with niche=real-estate pre-selected
Dark navy, gold, and electric blue premium design system
